#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> multiply(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int len = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int size = 1;
    while (size < len) size <<= 1;
    
    vector<double> ar(size, 0.0), ai(size, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
        long long x = ((long long)a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        ar[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
        ai[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    
    // FFT
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int bit = size >> 1;
        for (; (j & bit) != 0; bit >>= 1) j ^= bit;
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(ar[i], ar[j]);
            swap(ai[i], ai[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int step = 2; step <= size; step <<= 1) {
        int half = step >> 1;
        vector<double> cos(half), sin(half);
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            double angle = 2 * M_PI * i / step;
            cos[i] = cos(angle);
            sin[i] = sin(angle);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i += step) {
            for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                double cr = ar[i + k + half] * cos[k] - ai[i + k + half] * sin[k];
                double ci = ar[i + k + half] * sin[k] + ai[i + k + half] * cos[k];
                
                double ur = ar[i + k];
                double ui = ai[i + k];
                
                ar[i + k] = ur + cr;
                ai[i + k] = ui + ci;
                ar[i + k + half] = ur - cr;
                ai[i + k + half] = ui - ci;
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<double> br(size, 0.0), bi(size, 0.0);
    if (a == b) {
        br = ar;
        bi = ai;
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < b.size(); i++) {
            long long x = ((long long)b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            br[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
            bi[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        
        // FFT for b
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int bit = size >> 1;
            for (; (j & bit) != 0; bit >>= 1) j ^= bit;
            j ^= bit;
            if (i < j) {
                swap(br[i], br[j]);
                swap(bi[i], bi[j]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int step = 2; step <= size; step <<= 1) {
            int half = step >> 1;
            vector<double> cos(half), sin(half);
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                double angle = 2 * M_PI * i / step;
                cos[i] = cos(angle);
                sin[i] = sin(angle);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i += step) {
                for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                    double cr = br[i + k + half] * cos[k] - bi[i + k + half] * sin[k];
                    double ci = br[i + k + half] * sin[k] + bi[i + k + half] * cos[k];
                    
                    double ur = br[i + k];
                    double ui = bi[i + k];
                    
                    br[i + k] = ur + cr;
                    bi[i + k] = ui + ci;
                    br[i + k + half] = ur - cr;
                    bi[i + k + half] = ui - ci;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<double> resR(size, 0.0), resI(size, 0.0);
    double scale = 0.25 / size;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
        
        double a1r = ar[i] + ar[j];
        double a1i = ai[i] - ai[j];
        double a2r = ai[i] + ai[j];
        double a2i = ar[j] - ar[i];
        
        double b1r = br[i] + br[j];
        double b1i = bi[i] - bi[j];
        double b2r = bi[i] + bi[j];
        double b2i = br[j] - br[i];
        
        resR[i] = (a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r) * scale;
        resI[i] = (a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i) * scale;
    }
    
    // Inverse FFT
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int bit = size >> 1;
        for (; (j & bit) != 0; bit >>= 1) j ^= bit;
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(resR[i], resR[j]);
            swap(resI[i], resI[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int step = 2; step <= size; step <<= 1) {
        int half = step >> 1;
        vector<double> cos(half), sin(half);
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            double angle = -2 * M_PI * i / step;
            cos[i] = cos(angle);
            sin[i] = sin(angle);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i += step) {
            for (int k = 0; k < half; k++) {
                double cr = resR[i + k + half] * cos[k] - resI[i + k + half] * sin[k];
                double ci = resR[i + k + half] * sin[k] + resI[i + k + half] * cos[k];
                
                double ur = resR[i + k];
                double ui = resI[i + k];
                
                resR[i + k] = ur + cr;
                resI[i + k] = ui + ci;
                resR[i + k + half] = ur - cr;
                resI[i + k + half] = ui - ci;
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        resR[i] /= size;
        resI[i] /= size;
    }
    
    vector<int> result(len);
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        long long real = llround(resR[i]);
        long long imag = llround(resI[i]);
        long long low = real % mod;
        long long high = imag % mod;
        result[i] = (int)((low + (high << 15)) % mod);
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    vector<int> poly(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int idx;
        cin >> idx;
        poly[idx] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int exp = n / 2;
    
    while (true) {
        if (exp & 1) {
            ans = multiply(ans, poly, MOD);
        }
        exp >>= 1;
        if (exp == 0) break;
        poly = multiply(poly, poly, MOD);
    }
    
    long long sum = 0;
    for (int val : ans) {
        sum = (sum + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    
    cout << sum << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
